---
name: Company plan improvement
about: Propose a concrete product, business experiment or revision to one of the four plans.
title: "[Company] "
---

## Company and proposed change

Which of the four proposed companies is affected? Describe one bounded change and the next decision it enables.

## Customer and first offer

Who pays, what do they receive, and how do they buy it today? Include demand evidence or the test needed to obtain it.

## Delivery and dependencies

What work happens in Newfoundland? What must be purchased or partnered elsewhere? Identify the technical lead, rights, facility and qualification requirements. State which dependencies are verified.

## Capital and time

Give an estimate range with currency, price year, scope and operating runway. Separate CapEx, operating cost, working capital and contingency. Identify assumptions, exclusions and whether this replaces an existing estimate.

## Success and stop criteria

What result would justify the next investment? What result would make the team stop or change direction?

## Contribution and ownership

Link a draft using the company-plan template if useful. State the owner role needed and whether anyone has agreed to it. Contributions must be publishable under the repository's MIT License, with third-party rights identified.
